full_prompt_en: A square geometric mixed-media landscape shows a cluster of white waterside houses beneath a large golden moon, surrounded by deep blue patchwork sky and dark reflective water. The tall main house stands near the center-left, its pale walls marked by a few small dark windows and an orange-lit doorway. Two slim chimneys rise above a near-black roof. A lower white annex sits to the right, joining the main building at a small dark passage. The houses rest on a narrow dark embankment just above a horizontal strip of vivid orange at the far horizon. In the upper-right quarter, the full yellow moon is a nearly perfect circle, bright and flat against the blue. Small scattered black bird marks cross the upper sky, some passing close to the moon. The sky itself is constructed from large rectangular patches of slate blue, teal, and turquoise, with visible seams and rubbed textures. Across the lower half, water and shoreline break into broader rectangles of blue-black, ocher, olive, and muted gray. A line of orange stepping blocks begins at the bottom center and recedes diagonally toward a short stairway at the house entrance. To the right of this path, an orange reflection spreads in the water as a broad uneven vertical field, repeating the warm color of the moon and doorway. Near-black recesses beneath the houses and along the shore anchor the brighter shapes. Illumination feels stylized and low, with the moon and orange reflected bands supplying warm visual light while the white walls remain cool and matte. Scraped pigment, faint scratches, and uneven edges keep the colored blocks tactile despite their simple geometry. No readable lettering appears. The overall composition sets small upright buildings and a circular moon against a grid of dark blue planes, using a receding warm path to connect foreground water with the quiet distant shore.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形几何混合媒介风景描绘几座水边白色房屋立在巨大金黄月亮之下，四周是深蓝拼贴天空与暗色反光水面。较高的主屋位于中央偏左，浅色墙面有几扇小深窗和一个橙色发亮的门。近黑色屋顶上升起两根细烟囱。一座较低白色附屋位于右边，通过一处小的暗色通道与主屋相连。房屋落在窄窄深色堤岸上，后方远地平线上方横着一条鲜橙色带。右上四分之一处，满月是近乎完美的黄色圆形，在蓝色前明亮而平坦。细小散落的黑色鸟形笔迹越过上方天空，有些靠近月亮。天空本身由石板蓝、青绿和绿松石色的大矩形拼成，接缝与擦磨肌理可见。下半幅的水与岸分解成更宽阔的蓝黑、赭黄、橄榄色和低调灰色矩形。橙色踏步块从下方中央开始，沿斜线逐渐远去，通向房门前的短台阶。这条路右边，一片橙色倒影在水面铺成宽阔而不平的竖向色域，重复月亮与门口的暖色。房下与岸边的近黑凹处固定较亮形体。照明经过风格化并显得低暗，月亮和橙色反光色带提供视觉暖光，白墙仍保持冷色哑光。刮擦颜料、淡淡划痕和不齐边缘让简明几何色块仍有触感。没有可读文字。整体构图把小小直立的房屋和圆月置于深蓝色平面网格前，以逐渐远去的暖色道路连接前景水面与安静远岸。
style_prompt_en: The image has a geometric mixed-media finish composed of broad rectangular color planes, hard horizontal seams, and visibly rubbed pigment. Deep cobalt, teal, slate, and blue-black dominate, while compact orange and golden-yellow accents glow with unusual force. Simplified upright and circular shapes remain clearly legible within the patchwork; small scattered marks loosen the strict geometry. Surface wear, scratches, and uneven pigment edges give the flat blocks a matte tactile depth. Light is stylized through warm colored fields and their echoing reflections rather than detailed optical shading. A receding chain of small bright shapes crosses the darker lower area toward a compact middle focal group. The overall effect is quiet, graphic, and slightly dreamlike, with strong color geometry holding the space together.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有几何混合媒介完成面，由宽阔矩形色面、坚实水平接缝和明显擦磨的颜料构成。深钴蓝、青绿、石板蓝与蓝黑占主导，集中的橙色和金黄色强调则以罕见的力量发亮。简化的直立形与圆形在拼贴中仍清楚易读，散落的小笔迹使严格几何稍显松动。表面磨损、划痕和不齐颜料边缘赋予平面色块哑光触感和纵深。光线通过暖色色域及其呼应的反光进行风格化，而非依赖细致光学明暗。一串逐渐远去的小亮形穿过较暗的下部区域，通向紧凑的中部焦点群。整体效果安静、图形感鲜明且略似梦境，强烈色彩几何维持空间统一。
theme_en: White waterside houses beneath a yellow moon and blue patchwork sky
theme_zh: 黄色月亮与蓝色拼贴天空下的水边白房屋
name: George Birrell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
